name: process_workcenter_thead
label: User-defined Thead
description: Users can customize the `thead` to sort by custom fields, which can be used for querying, filtering, and reporting on process-related data.

fields.name: workcenter_uuid
fields.description: Unique identifier for category, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: user_uuid
fields.description: User, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: config_hash
fields.description: The user-defined `config_hash` field in the `thead` table. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the workcenter_uuid, user_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_hash
indexes.description: Standard index covering the config_hash field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
